author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

This PR improves how ActivityRegistry signals for the "easy cases" listed in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/51545 are emitted. It adds a `edm::signalslot::SignalSentry` helper class to call a given lambda either at `succeeded()` method (exception from the lambda propagated) or at the destructor (exception from the lambda not propagated).

The overall pattern followed here is
```c++
{
  
  auto sentry = edm::signalslot::make_sentry(<lambda for post signal>);
  <emit pre signal>

  <operation itself>

  sentry.succeeded();
}
```
Creating the sentry for the Post signal first makes the Post signal to be called also if Pre signal throws an exception, and the `succeeded()` method call allows exceptions from the Post signal (even if we recommend against those) to propagate if there isn't an exception in flight already.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2367

#### PR validation:

Unit tests pass
title: Improve how some ActivityRegistry signals are emitted
